title: AUDITING LARGE LANGUAGE MODELS: A THREE-LAYERED APPROACH

bias_targets.methodology: The paper does not conduct an empirical bias measurement itself; rather, it proposes a theoretical three-layered auditing blueprint (governance, model, and application audits). It recommends evaluating representational and allocational harms, as well as stereotyping of social groups, by using existing benchmark datasets (such as CrowS-Pairs, StereoSet, and Winogender) and word embedding metrics (such as SEAT, DisCo, and CAT).
